title: Home Maintenance Calendar
description: Generate a full 12-month home maintenance schedule: monthly chores, seasonal tasks and annual checks, laid out month by month.
howto: Pick the starting month (usually the current one).
Optionally tick if you have extras like a pool, fireplace or garden.
Press Generate for a 12-month calendar of tasks.
Check tasks off as you do them — progress is saved in your browser.

faqs.q: Where do the tasks come from?
faqs.a: A built-in checklist used by homeowner guides: monthly items (filters, detectors), seasonal items (gutters in fall, AC in spring) and annual checks.
Yes — in your browser's localStorage, keyed to the start month. Regenerating with a different start month gives a fresh list.
Tasks are ordered for northern-hemisphere seasons. Southern-hemisphere users can read the schedule shifted by 6 months — noted on the page.
